assumptions_and_limits: Friction is omitted; the accepted LOG's friction-energy line is zero.
No *DAMPING or *INITIAL CONDITIONS card is present; accepted LOG initial energy and damping work are zero.
The audit bounds only the current LINEAR pressure-overclosure contact storage represented by the endpoint tables and printed positive quadrature areas.
No exact integration is claimed because the DAT does not expose each springarea alongside its individual pressure and clearance; the per-pair maximum product is an upper bound.
No numerical dissipation, energy-control cause, or solver acceptance criterion is inferred; the snapshot is an immutable non-atomic prefix, not a terminal run result.

The logged native contact-energy term may share the separate compact-index issue. Even the full conservative contact-storage envelope is below the work-required contact term here; this does not identify the remaining discrepancy's cause.

area_nonnegative_source_proof: Current pinned mesh is C3D10-only. precontact.c loops each tie slave face through slavintpoints.f; faceinfo selects nopes=6 for these C3D10 tetra faces, and slavintpoints.f uses shape6tri and calls treatmasterface for the face overlap.
treatmasterface.f clips triangular patches with area=abs(det)/2 and supplies seven-point weights as 2*area*weight2d6(i).

gauss.f defines all seven weight2d6 values as positive; gencontelem_f2f.f consumes those weights and multiplies by the nonnegative shape-function Jacobian norm, then writes that area to springarea(1,igauss), so each generated quadrature spring weight is nonnegative.
springforc_f2f.f uses elas=-springarea*K*clear and senergy=-elas*clear/2 for LINEAR contact; printoutcontact.f sums springarea(1,igauss) for pair area.
method.cnum_and_row_validation: For both endpoints CDIS rows = CSTR rows = CNUM; ordered element+face keys match; every row mapped once; three pair-area prints (CF/CFN/CFS) agree for every pair.
method.energy_formula: U_contact = sum_i(0.5 * |p_i| * |clear_i| * springarea_i); upper bound uses each pair's max printed |p| and |clear|, each expanded by half an output ULP, times that pair's summed area expanded by half an output ULP.
method.pressure_overclosure_law: LINEAR K=10000 N/mm^3; reported pressure satisfies p=-K*clear within printed rounding for each row.
method.print_quantum: DAT and pair-area records use E13.6; upper limits add half the last printed decimal unit to pressure, clearance, and positive area before multiplying. LOG energy values use six digits after the mantissa decimal; their intervals use the same half-last-digit rule.
method.surface_mapping: Every DAT element+face key matched exactly one slave-face reference in hash-pinned contact-fragment.inc; pair index mapped to hash-pinned contact-manifest.json.

scope: Only the immutable accepted .019 and .020 s endpoints; no live output reads.
